justification: Union-find on threshold-passing edges produces a transitive partition; for any triangle (A,B,C) the edge-sum of the derived pairwise decisions is either 0 (records in different clusters) or 3 (records in the same cluster). No triangle can have edge-sum = 2 by construction.
note: To measure Dittos own per-pair decisions (without the union-find step) as a separate ablation, run Ditto warm-start K=100 on each edge and aggregate — this shows the per-pair encoder produces some triangle violations before clustering enforces transitivity.
